title: Consistent Hashing
subtitle: A hash ring moves a few keys when a node joins, and virtual nodes even out who holds them
motto: Change the cluster, not the map
keyInsight: Hashing keys onto a ring means adding a node moves only its neighbour's keys, and many virtual nodes per machine keep the shares even.

decisions.title: Run the real hash, not a formula
decisions.description: The sim places actual keys and nodes with a fixed hash, so the moved and imbalance numbers come from a run and not from 1/(n+1).
decisions.alternatives: Quoting the theory (K/n keys move) would hide how uneven one point per node really is.

decisions.title: Show the unevenness before the fix
decisions.description: The failure frame reports the busiest node's share with one point each, so virtual nodes arrive as an answer to a measured problem.
decisions.alternatives: Introducing virtual nodes up front would present them as decoration.
